An Act to amend the Australian Civilian Corps Act 2011, and for related purposes

content.p: This Act may be cited as the Australian Civilian Corps Amendment Act 2013.
This Act commences on the day this Act receives the Royal Assent.

Each Act, and each set of regulations or directions, that is specified in a Schedule to this Act is amended or repealed as set out in the applicable items in the Schedule concerned, and any other item in a Schedule to this Act has effect according to its terms.
The amendment of any regulation under subsection (1) does not prevent the regulation, as so amended, from being amended or repealed by the Governor-General.

The amendment of any direction under subsection (1) does not prevent the direction, as so amended, from being amended or repealed by the Prime Minister or the Secretary of the Department (as the case requires).

content.p: amended Act means the Australian Civilian Corps Act 2011 as in force after the commencement of this Part.

(b) the Prime Minister’s Australian Civilian Corps Directions;

AusAID means the Australian Agency for International Development.

(c) the Director-General’s Australian Civilian Corps Directions.

hcontainer.name: item
hcontainer.heading: Effect of things done by, or in relation to, AusAID etc. under the old Act

content.p: A thing done before the commencement of this Part by, or in relation to, AusAID or the Director-General under a provision of the old Act has effect after that commencement, for the purposes of the amended Act, as if the thing had been done by, or in relation to, the Department or the Secretary (as the case requires) under that provision of the amended Act.
Subitem (1) does not apply to the making of an instrument.

Directions issued by the Director-General under section 13 or 16 of the old Act and in force immediately before the commencement of this Part continue in effect after that commencement as if they were directions issued by the Secretary under section 13 or 16 of the amended Act (as the case requires).
Note: These directions, as continued in effect, are amended as set out in Part 4.

hcontainer.name: item
hcontainer.heading: Effect of things done by, or in relation to, AusAID etc. under the old legislative instruments

content.p: A thing done before the commencement of this Part by, or in relation to, AusAID, the Director-General or an employee of AusAID under a provision of an old legislative instrument has effect after that commencement, for the purposes of the relevant amended legislative instrument, as if the thing had been done by, or in relation to, the Department, the Secretary or an employee of the Department (as the case requires) under that provision of the amended legislative instrument.
Subitem (1) does not apply to the making of an instrument.

hcontainer.name: item
hcontainer.heading: Transitional determinations relating to non-legislative instruments

content.p: The Secretary may determine in writing that an instrument, other than a legislative instrument, made by the Director-General under the old Act, or under an old legislative instrument, and in force immediately before the commencement of this Part, continues in effect after that commencement as if it had been made by the Secretary under the amended Act or under the amended legislative instrument (as the case requires).
A determination under subitem (1) may also:

provide that a reference in the instrument to AusAID, to the Director-General, or to another person or matter related to AusAID, is instead to be taken to be a reference to the Department, to the Secretary, or to another person or matter related to the Department; or
provide for how a thing done under the instrument before the commencement of this Part is to continue to have effect.
A determination under subitem (1) is not a legislative instrument.
